name: Wikidata (API and Query Service)
tier_rationale: Wikimedia Foundation, Inc., an established non-profit with published terms and policies (A8 trusted); P224 tier trusted and P361 'Wikimedia ... trusted'.

reliability.justification: Community-edited knowledge base: P856 official website is labelled 'official site per Wikidata (community-edited)' at confidence <= 0.7 and never sets known_good (P224).

wbapi.title: Wikidata API (wbsearchentities, wbgetentities, wbgetclaims) and Special:EntityData

terms.quote: 'open' = free use, internal business use included (public domain, CC0, CC BY, open government data, and permissive or copyleft licences whose obligations V3LUM meets by runtime download and attribution, A6)

wbapi.notes: Quote: binding council text (A1 decision, docs/COUNCIL_1.md). Class 'open' is the P224 chair-file class; research C0523 records the data as CC0. www.wikidata.org/w/api.php wbsearchentities, wbgetentities, wbgetclaims for P6204 (CNPJ), P856 (official website), P749 (parent) and P355 (subsidiary), plus wiki/Special:EntityData/{QID}.json (P224, P361).

sparql.title: Wikidata Query Service SPARQL (fixed templates only, LIMIT <= 20, 20 s timeout)

terms.quote: 'open' = free use, internal business use included (public domain, CC0, CC BY, open government data, and permissive or copyleft licences whose obligations V3LUM meets by runtime download and attribution, A6)

sparql.notes: Quote: binding council text (A1 decision, docs/COUNCIL_1.md). Class 'open' is the P224 chair-file class; research C0523 records the data as CC0. query.wikidata.org/sparql: free-form SPARQL is never sent, only fixed templates with LIMIT <= 20 and a 20 s timeout (P224); 429 = RATE_LIMITED.

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G10-3, p3-G10-1: batches only extend it (wikidata__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). www.wikidata.org added: the API is on www (research C0523) and wikidata.org redirects there. BINDING PROFILE_REQUIREMENTS (www.wikidata.org, query.wikidata.org): user_agent 'V3LUM/{version} (+{contact}) python-requests' (Wikimedia User-Agent policy; a UA without contact got 429), applied to every host of this provider; without setting contact_email it is SKIPPED reason_code 'config' (P224). min_interval 1 s (P224); timeout 20 s for the SPARQL templates. meta.wikimedia.org (batch p3-G05-3) is another provider.
